zenstory-ai-novel-to-game-game-qa.description: Blind-playtest and verify a game on its target runtime as a first-time player without reading source code. Run an isolated first-time playthrough first to uncover onboarding, guidance, interaction, pacing, and mobile viewport issues, then reconcile against design specs and write one complete-run verification record. Use for blind playtest a generated game, QA a game build as a new player, audit first-run playability, or verify a game build. 游戏实机盲玩与运行验收。先以未读源码与设计文档的新玩家身份在目标运行环境中从头盲玩，排查上手引导、操作流程、视听节奏与视口适配问题，再对照设计规范核实定性，并用单次完整通关记录生成验收文件。用于新玩家视角盲测游戏、诊断实机体验问题或验收构建版本。
